history.unprotectHelp: This point will become eligible for automatic rotation. Current progress and its recent safety points stay. Remove protection only if you no longer need to keep this point.
history.policy: Ordinary history rotates: 10 recent points, daily samples for 7 days and weekly samples for 4 weeks. Above 80% usage, older ordinary points are removed first. Protect important progress; protected points still count toward your quota.
history.preview: Remove {count} revisions, reducing usage by {size}. Estimated disk space released: {disk}.
history.keepHelp: Current progress, recent safety points and {count} protected revisions will stay.
history.sharedHelp: All files in a revision are removed together. Files shared with retained history stay; disk reclamation can be smaller than the quota reduction.
history.empty: There is no removable history in this profile.
history.changed: History or protection changed. Review the updated history before trying again.
history.cleaned: Removed {count} revisions and released {size} of disk space. Current progress is unchanged.
history.pending: History cleanup is committed. Some disk reclamation is pending and will retry automatically; you can also retry below.
